answer: Admission uses a rotating sponsor auction. A sponsor may back one newcomer for 30 tokens, but its kth active referral costs 30k^2, so referrals 1, 2, and 3 lock 30, 120, and 270 tokens for 28 days. Every 9 hours, 5 VRF jurors inspect 4 independent job receipts and publish the hash delta in a violet ledger. Two copied receipts burn 80% of the sponsor pool and suspend every linked referral for 45 days, so a nectar-sweet Sybil swarm becomes progressively dearer and verifiably punishable.
